messages.subject: error in percMethylation() function
parts:
Dear Altuna,

I am trying to use percMethylation() function on my sample data. I am using methylKit0.9.2 version.

percMethylation() seems to give variable results (little variation is expected) depending on how I process my data. I explain the issue with the following options

option1 works with out any error
methylRawList object ==>regionCounts()==>unite()==> percMethylation()

option2 gives wrong values
methylRawList object ==>unite()==>regionCounts()==> percMethylation()

To my understanding you are calculating percMethylation from the numCs.index and numTs.index values. In option2, I notice that there is an additonal column 'id' and 'covered' in the data from regionCounts() function. And hence the indexes are wrong and gives wrong values.

I am not sure if I have done any mistake from my part. I am attaching a slide to explain it better. Kindly give your input. Also shower some light on the additional columns generated in option2.

 error_percMethylation_function.pdf


Regards,
Kalyan

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: error in percMethylation() function
parts:
Hi Kalyan,
That issue should be fixed in the development version but I haven't updated the master version. You can install the development version as follows:
# dependencies
install.packages( c("data.table","devtools"))
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite(c("GenomicRanges","IRanges"))

# install the development version from github
library(devtools)
install_github("methylKit", username = "al2na",ref = "development",build_vignettes=FALSE)

In addition, thanks for replying to questions/issues in the forum.

Best,
Altuna
